fieldValues.chose: Closed the cycle 2026-10-29 11:30 to 2026-10-30 11:30 UTC. Nine group PRs merged, all by the owner, so no delegated budget was used. srs-web: #636 (conversations view, merged 11:36 on 10-29, just after the previous close; reviewer reject, remedy 2910ac1e not affirmed), #645 (essay comments: kinds, filter, Done/Reject/Reopen) and #652 (comments review follow-ups) with no reviewer quorum comment found, #646 (?new=<editor>, approve, remedy 44a6f76d affirmed), #647 (editor help as data, approve, decision 9441693e), #650 (essay editor help in the owner's words), #660 (ui_help and ui_highlight, approve, decision 9441693e), #659 (help dialog; reviewer reject on a pr-check wording finding). srs-rust#1524 (changes since last save or cursor, reviewer reject: its ruling, remedy 800f223f, does not cover SP-52; gates green). fieldValues.rationale: No new escalation. Whether remedy 2910ac1e is affirmed (a human fork into Affirmed) and whether a remedy answers SP-52 are the owner's acts; the owner merged the PRs that cite them, so they are repeated as inform items, not filed twice.
